blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House prosecution panel withdrew Civil Service Commission (CSC) Assistant Commissioner Ariel Ronquillo as a witness on the preparation and filing of Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN). Ronquillo was supposed to be the first witness of the week, but House prosecutor Rep. Terry Ridon said Ronquillo’s testimony would no longer be needed since the previous witness, retired Sandiganbayan Associate Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang, had already covered the topic. “Hindi na po isasalang si Atty. Ariel Ronquillo… bilang testigo ngayong araw na ito, partikular dahil nasapatan na po kami sa testimonya ni Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang at Atty. […]...
